  "description": "Ultimum Limited is a fast-growing alcoholic &amp; non-alcoholic Beverage&rsquo;s manufacturing company and Nigerian-based subsidiary of Union Camerounaise de Brasseries &ndash; a leading Total Beverages Manufacturer with over 50 years presence and tremendous success in Cameroon; also, a proud sponsor of the 2024 African Cup of Nations (AFCON) in Abidjan. Ivory Coast. We are committed to developing quality products that satisfy all aspirations of our customers, and constantly innovating on ways to improve our products and deliver quality and special experience for our customers.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Marketing Manager

Job Location: Abia
Job type: Full Time

Job Purpose


	The Marketing Manager will coordinate and develop marketing policies, programs and campaigns to drive the visibility, awareness, acceptance and growth of all ULs brands across the target markets and commercial regions.
	The incumbent will lead market research and other relevant briefs to obtain insights and identify opportunities for growth, and recommend necessary actions.


Key Job Roles Responsibilities


	Develop, integrate and execute the Annual Marketing and consumer plans in line with regional commercial strategies, company objectives, success metrics, activity calendars, including Innovation projects and end to end marketing.
	Oversee digital and traditional marketing campaigns, ensuring they align with brand objectives
	Regularly monitor sales volume and share growth against the plan and recommend necessary revisions and/or solutions.
	Monitor competitors activities including dealer, consumer trends, new launches and recommend appropriate and innovative marketing solutions when/where necessary.
	Plan brand operations while maintaining strict control on budget and expenditures.
	Formulate, discuss and finalize with Commercial Directors and Commercial Managers a company-wide brand awareness policy.
	Provide input on regional brand plans (activities, calendars, execution of allocated Direct Marketing Expenses and local innovation opportunities).
	Co-create on development of market-level innovation projects.
	Oversee regionalization and real-time amplification of campaigns within the commercial regions, providing input to relevant Commercial Unit team.
	Provide oversight on brand activation at the country level, including POSM activations, consumer promotions, experiential marketing, and events (leveraging brand assets), in coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
	Determine the need, objectives and required actions for consumer promotions and programs.
	Develop strategies to ensure effective and measurable in-store execution of promotional items such as coolers, in-store signs, etc.
	Conduct market research and other research briefs, and analyze all the necessary data (including distribution, total market share by flavour, pricing effects, perceptions, etc) to identify new growth opportunities, understand consumer behaviour and recommend actions as necessary.
	Ensure expeditious communication of research data to management and maintain costs of obtaining research within budget.
	Identify needs for campaign localization or customization as necessary.
	Work closely with Platform services to ensure timely procurement process management and compliance related to brand activations.
	Support capability building by providing necessary coaching / training to the Commercial team.
	Perform other duties as required by the job and/or management.


Experience &amp; Academic Requirements


	University Degree or HND in Marketing or any other related discipline (Postgraduate qualifications will be an advantage).
	Minimum of 7 years of cognate experience in Marketing, with 5 years managerial experience within the FMCG or Brand Marketing organization.
	Demonstrable experience developing simple, compelling strategies and able to transform complex scenarios into simple strategies.
	Experience in consumer communication development and evaluation (ATL, &amp; BTL).
	Proven experience developing and launching new consumer products.
	Experienced at managing agencies and partners to build amazing relationships
	Expert in the application of brand positioning to drive brand growth.
	Experience working in cross-functional and cross-geographical teams is preferred.
	Proven track record of working successfully with Sales) Commercial) teams.


Key Competency Requirements:


	Strong business / commercial acumen (general marketing, sales and advertising knowledge)
	Expert in brand activation and execution of marketing plans
	Good Project Management skills.
	Excellent communication, listening and interpersonal skills.
	Culturally sensitive and/or able to manage diversity
	Strong ethics &amp; integrity.
	Good with change management, adaptability and dealing with uncertainty.
	Excellent negotiation Skills
	Good problem solving &amp; decision-making skills
	Results Driven/Detail Oriented.

  "description": "DreamCity Property &amp; Investment Limited stands at the forefront of residential and commercial real estate development and investment across Nigeria&#39;s major urban centers. We are dedicated to delivering dependable structures supported by qualified infrastructure, premium luxury apartments in high-demand districts, and commercial properties that generate robust returns for our investors. Our continued success is built on a foundation of trust and partnership with our investors, who have become integral to our growth story.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Graphic Designer

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Position Overview


	We are seeking a creative and strategic Graphic Designer with specialized experience in the real estate, financial, and hospitality sectors.
	The ideal candidate will translate complex investment concepts and property values into compelling visual narratives.
	You will be responsible for creating a wide range of digital and print materials that elevate our brands, support sales and marketing initiatives, and ensure consistent communication across all business verticals.


Key Responsibilities


	Conceptualize, design, and produce high-quality marketing collateral for real estate properties, including brochures, site plans, promotional banners, and digital advertisements.
	Develop clear, engaging, and compliant visual materials for REIT investment listings, fund presentations, and investor reports that communicate financial data effectively.
	Create branding and digital assets for our fintech and hospitality ventures, including user interface (UI) graphics, web elements, social media content, and promotional campaigns.
	Ensure all visual output adheres to each company&#39;s brand guidelines, maintaining consistency and a premium brand identity across all touchpoints.
	Collaborate closely with the marketing, sales, and investment teams to understand project objectives and translate business goals into impactful visual solutions.
	Manage multiple design projects from concept to final delivery, ensuring deadlines are met within a fast-paced environment.
	Prepare and optimize graphics for various outputs, including print production, web, mobile, and social media platforms.
	Stay current with design trends, especially in real estate and fintech marketing, and propose innovative ideas to enhance visual communication.
	Maintain and organize a digital library of assets, including photos, logos, and design files.
	Provide design support for corporate presentations, event materials, and internal communications as required.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s degree or HND in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field.
	A minimum of 3 years of professional graphic design experience, with a verifiable portfolio demonstrating work for real estate, financial/investment, or hospitality clients.
	Relevant professional certification (e.g., Adobe Certified Expert, Certified Graphic Designer) is highly advantageous.
	Expert proficiency in industry-standard design software, primarily the Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma.

Our continued success is built on a foundation of trust and partnership with our investors, who have become integral to our growth story.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Graphic Designer

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos

	The ideal candidate will translate complex investment concepts and property values into compelling visual narratives.

Key Responsibilities


	Conceptualize, design, and produce high-quality marketing collateral for real estate properties, including brochures, site plans, promotional banners, and digital advertisements.

	Create branding and digital assets for our fintech and hospitality ventures, including user interface (UI) graphics, web elements, social media content, and promotional campaigns.
	Ensure all visual output adheres to each company's brand guidelines, maintaining consistency and a premium brand identity across all touchpoints.
	Collaborate closely with the marketing, sales, and investment teams to understand project objectives and translate business goals into impactful visual solutions.
	Manage multiple design projects from concept to final delivery, ensuring deadlines are met within a fast-paced environment.
	Prepare and optimize graphics for various outputs, including print production, web, mobile, and social media platforms.
